_ember2PostNote: HARNESS ARTEFACT, not a game defect — corrected. Every frame the STATION probe took on ember-2 (_shots/play_untest_ember-2/*.png) carries strong radial white speed-lines and chromatic fringing while the hero is idle at speed 0. The LOOK pass on the same course, same build, minutes later, shows none (_shots/play_look_ember-2/01_ember-2_06_S.png). The difference is how the hero got there: the station probe teleports repeatedly with `__dev.tp`, which appears to latch the speed-line post effect on. Do not file it as a rendering defect; do treat any station-probe frame on a course where it appears as unusable for a colour or legibility read.
